lines.text: You are standing on my line. Not that one. The gravity channel under your feet. Step left.
Sixteen generations of Keths have kept these wells. Point one: water belongs to nobody. Point two: I count every cup. Do not ask me to reconcile them.
If it is nobody's, why count?
Because nobody's water still runs out. Good question, girl. Do not let it go to your head.

choice.text: Could we carry a flask back for the crew? I will bring it back full.
Just take a flask from the stack.
The Dominion offered you a pump, I hear.

lines.text: Asking first. Adequate. One flask. The flask returns or I come looking.
They offered. I listened. Listening is free. Signing is not.
